Shanghai Municipal Council Report 1913

Report for the Year 1913 and Budget for the Year 1914
Shanghai Municipal Council, Shanghai, 1914

All tables and lists are transcribed, including small tables set in the text, the list of calls, the staff list, the accounts and the budget (each department or sub-head of the financial statement and budget is a separate table); the prose, the photographs, the plague and fire-district maps, the weather diagram and the electricity graphs are not. Table pages were found from contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5; light pages were read once by Claude Haiku 5.5, dense and wide pages by Claude Sonnet 5.5. Not checked by eye. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Figures that could not be read are marked [?] (58 cells). Chapters follow the printed contents (three page series, 1A–116A, 1B–144B and 1C–96C, as printed).
